payload.entry: Engine phase complete. Notes fold per (account, calendar, event/series); a newer foreign note no longer hides this account, and a clear under A clears only A. Held rows report action=held with the journaled buffer, skip vault writes and extra gcal.row, print no ~, and stay status=unchanged; a deliberate clear is never held. Provenance fields drop root unless the chosen root is note/series_note and drop bullets when description is off or the event is not a task. A winning note route strips an aliased title token (Breakfast @fam -> Breakfast). Verified: cargo test --test gcal_notes (21 passed, including two-account fold/clear, two-run hold, fields omit, aliased title, no-hold when malformed=0); cargo test --lib notes_fold and note_route; just check (fmt, clippy, workspace tests). No --epic-symbol leftovers. No fixtures changed.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: gcal.note fold ties on (ts, host) when two hosts write the same key within one second; last-writer-wins then depends on host ordering, so a clear written in the same second as the note from another host could lose the fold — consider a monotonic tiebreak (path, line already cover same-host)

All 9 select fixes land with tests: pre-note google_event clone (cleared preview shows Google values; regenerated tests/fixtures/gcal_note/json/cleared.json — the only fixture changed), argv pre-pass honors note options anywhere before -- with attached-value and -30min TEXT handling, orphan -c clears by key incl. bare series masters, lookup outages warn instead of orphaning, cancelled/declined/gone beat past-hiding with series judged by master status, list JSON keys by mode (-a=events), show warns on foreign-account notes, URL fallback warning prints with the error in human+JSON (GoogleError.with_warnings), enriched picker rows and scope prompt. Verified: cargo test --workspace 10472 passed 0 failed; fmt clean; clippy gate clean; docs-check shows only the 5 known mounted-page budget failures tracked by jz/h9.
